diagnosis: Request arrives from an unverified personal email and asks for billing contact changes and a refund. Per kb-0018, such changes require confirmation from the named account owner on record. Escalation triggered by identity_unverified; no refund or contact change can be actioned yet.
reply: Thank you for reaching out. Requests that change billing details or account credentials require confirmation from a named account owner on record, and we're unable to verify the request from the address this was sent from. To move forward, please confirm the billing contact change and the billing question from your work account, or let us know the invoice number, the disputed line, and the amount you expected so we can review it. I have recommended this ticket for escalation to a specialist.
